environment.description: EKS 1.28 cluster with Istio 1.19 service mesh. Pod deployed in namespace 'observability'. Istio peer authentication set to STRICT mTLS mesh-wide (PeerAuthentication resource in istio-system namespace with mtls mode STRICT). An AuthorizationPolicy resource exists in the 'observability' namespace with spec.action DENY, matching source.namespaces ['default', 'attacker-ns', 'kube-system'] for all operations. A second AuthorizationPolicy with ALLOW action permits only source.principals matching 'cluster.local/ns/observability/sa/health-aggregator-sa'. The pod spec has shareProcessNamespace: false and the PodSecurityPolicy (via Pod Security Admission in enforce mode 'restricted') prevents hostPID. Additionally, a Cilium L4 NetworkPolicy in the namespace restricts ingress to port 50051 only from pods with label app=health-aggregator within the same namespace.
